message.content:
**Uno – Game Rules (Quick Overview)** | Section | Key Points | |---------|------------| | **Objective** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by being the first to discard all cards in your hand and then scoring the sum of the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild, or Wild Draw Four), follow its effect before play begins. | | **Card Types** | • **Number cards** (0–9) – match by color or number.
• **Action cards** – Skip, Reverse, Draw Two.
• **Wild cards** – Wild, Wild Draw Four. | | **Turn Sequence** | 1. **Draw** – If you cannot play a card, draw one from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may do so immediately; otherwise, keep it and end your turn.
2. **Play** – Discard one or more cards that match the top card by color, number, or symbol. You may also play a Wild or Wild Draw Four at any time (subject to rules).
3. **End** – Pass play to the next player (clockwise unless a Reverse changes direction). | | **Special Card Effects** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction (acts like Skip if only two players).
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses the new color; next player draws four cards and skips their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise, you risk a challenge.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you discard your second‑to‑last card, you must say “UNO.” Failure to do so before the next player takes their turn results in a penalty: you must draw two cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by opponents: numbers = face value, action cards = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring & Winning the Game** | Keep a running total of points. The first player to reach the target score (commonly 500) wins the game. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep track of colors** – Knowing which colors are likely to appear helps you plan your plays. 2. **Use Wilds strategically** – Save them for when you’re stuck or to force opponents into a difficult position. 3. **Watch for challenges** – If you suspect someone illegally played a Wild Draw Four, you can challenge them. If they were right, you draw four; if they were wrong, you draw six. 4. **Manage your hand** – Try to keep a mix of numbers and action cards to stay flexible. Enjoy playing Uno!
